reason: The carousel is all about letters and measurements. I see no client, no result and no local shop I would recognise, so I cannot tell what a better brand would do for my takings. A free look is harmless, but I would not hand over my brand to a studio I know nothing about.
objection: Nothing here proves that better design brings in customers. Pretty letters are not the same as more people walking through my door.
would_change_my_mind: A real business like mine, nearby or similar, showing its before and after with the customer numbers that changed.
